invariants.rationale: It is standard defensive programming to check if the input string is not null before processing.
This expresses that 'name' is always either empty or not empty, a property of any string. (Note: If discouraged due to triviality, it can be omitted.)
String.length() is always non-negative per Java specification if 'name' is not null.
Layer/image names typically do not contain line breaks; unless otherwise specified, it's a reasonable invariant.
